lines.en: label ayanenew3:
scene black
scene ayanenewthree1
The day came to an end a long time ago and I still haven’t left.
lines.zh: 这一天早就结束了，而我还没走。

lines.en: Which, of course, means that Ayane hasn’t left either as staying late with me under the guise of cleaning duty is the type of convenient excuse a girl like her lives for.
lines.zh: 当然，这也意味着 Ayane 也没走，因为以值日的名义留下来陪我，正是她这种女孩赖以生存的便利借口。

lines.en: No cleaning was done today, as you have probably guessed.
lines.zh: 今天一点卫生都没打扫，你大概也猜到了。

lines.en: In fact, not much of anything was done today.
lines.zh: 事实上，今天几乎什么都没干。

lines.en: Time ticked by and the sun disappeared without much of anything happening at all.
lines.zh: 时间一分一秒过去，太阳落了下去，什么都没发生。

lines.en: And something about the way the light of the moon pierces the window and lands on me erases any chance I have to contemplate how or why that happened.
lines.zh: 而月光穿透窗户、落在我身上的那种方式，不知怎的抹去了我所有去思考这一切是怎么发生、又为何发生的余地。

lines.en: I’m just here.
lines.zh: 我只是待在这里。

lines.en: Ayane is here too, but the main thing is that {i}I’m{/i} here.
lines.zh: Ayane 也在这里，但重点是{i}我{/i}在这儿。

lines.en: I’m here.
lines.zh: 我在这儿。

lines.en: This is my world now.
lines.zh: 现在这就是我的世界。

lines.en: And despite the irrational thoughts that have been crawling through every inch of...whatever section of the brain creates what is {i}supposed{/i} to be rational thought-
lines.zh: 尽管那些非理性的念头已经爬过了大脑里……负责制造{i}所谓{/i}理性思维的那块区域的每一寸——

lines.en: Despite that, I am here.
lines.zh: 尽管如此，我在这儿。

lines.en: Alone, even with the warm body of a young girl beside me.
lines.zh: 孤单一个人，即使身旁就有一个年轻女孩温热的身体。

lines.en: : It’s beautiful, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 很美，不是吗？

lines.en: : What is?
lines.zh: : 什么很美？

lines.en: : The sky...The moon...All of it.
lines.zh: : 天空……月亮……这一切。

lines.en: : There’s something really magical about looking up at the stars on a hot summer night.
lines.zh: : 在炎热的夏夜里抬头看星星，真的有种很神奇的感觉。

lines.en: : It’s just one of those things that makes your mind and your body go, “Ahh...youth!”
lines.zh: : 就是那种会让你的身心一起发出“啊……青春！”的事情之一。

lines.en: : You know?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？

lines.en: It would be nice to leech such trivial, little thoughts from whatever it is that causes celestial bodies to glow.
lines.zh: 要是能从那个让天体发光的东西身上，汲取一点这样微不足道的小念头，该有多好。

lines.en: It’s something about energy, I’m assuming- which may partially explain the second wind Ayane is feeling all of a sudden.
lines.zh: 我猜这跟能量有关——这或许也部分解释了 Ayane 为什么突然来了精神。

lines.en: I wonder if this light would have the same effect on me if it were not for the transparent barrier I hide behind.
lines.zh: 我在想，如果不是我躲在那层透明的屏障后面，这光会不会对我有同样的效果。

lines.en: : Is something going on, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : You’ve been acting off ever since school ended. And I’ve got a feeling that whatever it is runs a little deeper than just exhaustion.
lines.zh: : 从放学起你就一直怪怪的。而且我有种感觉，不管那是什么，都比单纯的疲劳要深一点。

lines.en: : Do you want to talk about it?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: : There’s not really anything {i}to{/i} talk about. I feel the same as always.
lines.zh: : 其实没什么{i}好聊的{/i}。我跟平时一样。

lines.en: : Is that supposed to reassure me? Because it really just makes it sound like you’re putting on some sort of front all the time.
lines.zh: : 这话是为了让我放心吗？因为它听起来更像是你一直在装样子。

lines.en: : Like...you’re pretending to be someone you’re not.
lines.zh: : 就像……你在假装成另一个人。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree2
: Well, if you change your mind, I’ll be right beside you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是你改变主意了，我就在你身边。

lines.en: : You already know that I’d do anything for you, so consider me staying a little later today as one more testament in Ayane Amamiya’s love bible.
lines.zh: : 你早就知道我愿意为你做任何事，所以就把我今天多留一会儿，当成 Ayane Amamiya 爱的圣经里的又一条见证吧。

lines.en: : If anyone else asks, we’re going to have to stick to the cleaning duty excuse. “Love Bible” doesn’t sound like a legitimate excuse.
lines.zh: : 要是别人问起来，我们还是得咬定值日那个借口。“爱的圣经”听起来不像个正当理由。

lines.en: : To be honest, I doubt anyone would believe any sort of excuse we gave them to explain me staying after school with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我怀疑不管我们拿出什么借口，来解释我放学后跟你待在一起，都不会有人信，Sensei。

lines.en: : This might be a little hard to believe, but my love for you is pretty widely understood among us girls.
lines.zh: : 这话也许有点难信，但我们女生之间，基本都知道我有多爱你。

lines.en: : I’m surprised Ami showed no resistance to this if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，我还挺意外 Ami 居然没反对。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s {i}that{/i} surprising. Especially considering that Ami probably noticed something was wrong as well.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没什么好{i}意外{/i}的。尤其是考虑到 Ami 大概也察觉到你有点不对劲。

lines.en: : Nothing is wrong, though.
lines.zh: : 可我没什么不对劲啊。

lines.en: : Then I guess Ami was okay with it because she noticed {i}nothing{/i} was wrong.
lines.zh: : 那我想，Ami 之所以同意，是因为她注意到确实{i}没什么{/i}。

lines.en: : I know I obsess over you literally all the time, but I know when I should stop. And I think that even if Ami wishes I’d flirt with you a little less...that she trusts me with your heart.
lines.zh: : 我知道自己无时无刻不在痴迷你，但我知道什么时候该收手。而且我觉得，就算 Ami 希望我少跟你调情一点……她还是放心把你的心交给我。

lines.en: : That’s a bad move. I don’t even trust you with my heart.
lines.zh: : 这步棋走错了。我连自己都不放心把心交给你。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree3
: You don’t?
lines.zh: : 你不放心？

lines.en: : Of course not. It’s nothing personal, though, since there’s not anyone I would trust with something as important as that.
lines.zh: : 当然不。不过这不是针对你，因为那么重要的东西，我谁都不会托付。

lines.en: : It might sound romantic to some people to have someone they can be open and honest with but, to me, that sounds-
lines.zh: : 对有些人来说，能有一个可以敞开心扉、坦诚相对的人听起来很浪漫，但对我来说，那听起来——

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree4
: I get it. I really do.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我真的懂。

lines.en: : Maybe not 100%%, but I can relate to the whole “Not wanting to open up to someone” thing.
lines.zh: : 也许不是百分之百懂，但“不想对别人敞开心扉”这件事，我很有共鸣。

lines.en: : You say, despite opening up way too much to me almost every single day.
lines.zh: : 你说这话，明明自己几乎每天都对我敞开得不能再敞开了。

lines.en: : Ahh, there’s the difference, Sensei. The door you’re referring to was left open for way too long and doesn’t close anymore.
lines.zh: : 啊，这就是区别所在了，Sensei。你说的那扇门敞开得太久，已经关不上了。

lines.en: : But there are plenty of other doors in my house that lead to different rooms...and I doubt that I’d open those up to even you right now.
lines.zh: : 可我那栋房子里还有很多别的门，通向不同的房间……而现在，那些门我恐怕连你都不会打开。

lines.en: : Then I guess you {i}can{/i} relate in some way.
lines.zh: : 那我想，你也{i}算是{/i}有共鸣吧。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree2
: Of course I can. I’m your future wife.
lines.zh: : 当然有。我可是你的未来妻子。

lines.en: : And I’m sure there will be plenty of nights in the future where the two of us gather beneath the stars- sharing all sorts of worries or secrets or...anything we want to share with one another.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定，未来会有很多个夜晚，我们两个聚在星空下——分享各种各样的烦恼、秘密，或者……任何我们想跟彼此分享的东西。

lines.en: : It’s just a little hard for us right now since the real stuff will just come across as annoying.
lines.zh: : 只是现在对我们来说有点难，因为那些真正重要的事，听起来只会让人觉得烦。

lines.en: : You’re a lot more perceptive than you look, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你比看起来敏锐多了，Ayane。

lines.en: : Are you calling me ugly?
lines.zh: : 你是在说我丑吗？

lines.en: : What? No.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。

lines.en: : Good. Because if you were calling me ugly, I would throw myself out of this window.
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为如果你是在说我丑，我就要从这扇窗户跳下去。

lines.en: : Please don’t. That sounds like an incredibly stressful situation to deal with.
lines.zh: : 千万别。那听起来会是个压力大到难以应付的局面。

lines.en: : And I guess...
lines.zh: : 而且我想……

lines.en: : I might miss you a little if you were gone.
lines.zh: : 如果你不在了，我大概会有点想你。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree5
: Did you just-
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是不是——

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : I could have sworn I just heard you say something actually romantic for...probably the first time ever.
lines.zh: : 我敢发誓，我刚刚听到你说了句真的很浪漫的话……大概是有史以来第一次。

lines.en: : Is saying I’d miss you {i}a little{/i} really that romantic?
lines.zh: : 说我会{i}有点{/i}想你，真的有那么浪漫吗？

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree6
: You {i}did{/i} say it! Oh my God! I wish Ami was here to see this!
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}说了！我的天！我真希望 Ami 能在这儿看到！

lines.en: : I feel like that would significantly increase the chances of you ending up as a puddle of flesh and blood on the concrete below us.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那样的话，你变成我们脚下混凝土上一摊血肉的概率会大幅上升。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree7
: Then, at least I would die happy...
lines.zh: : 那至少我会死得很幸福……

lines.en: scene black
The night gets darker and the reasons we have to stick around reduce to somewhere near zero.
lines.zh: 夜色渐深，而我们还有理由留在这里的原因已经趋近于零。

lines.en: But even with that in mind, the two of us feel a shared inclination to go higher rather than lower.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，我们两个都生出一种共同的念头：往上走，而不是往下。

lines.en: And I follow Ayane as she begins to move toward the wrong set of stairs.
lines.zh: 我跟着 Ayane，她开始朝那道不该走的楼梯走去。

lines.en: scene ayanenewthree8
I continue following her until we can go no higher.
lines.zh: 我继续跟着她，直到我们再也无法往上。

lines.en: Through an unlocked door and onto the roof of the school-
lines.zh: 穿过一扇没锁的门，来到学校的楼顶——

lines.en: Up a ladder, then another-
lines.zh: 爬上一道梯子，再爬一道——

lines.en: And before long, we are free to look down on everything and everyone.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我们就可以自由地俯瞰一切、俯瞰所有人。

lines.en: That power is quickly diminished and made irrelevant by the simple fact that I can see nothing from up here.
lines.zh: 但这股力量很快就被削弱、变得无关紧要，原因很简单：从这里我什么也看不见。

lines.en: But still-
lines.zh: 但尽管如此——

lines.en: Something about it allows me to relax my shoulders.
lines.zh: 这其中的某种东西，让我放松了肩膀。

lines.en: I am more unguarded when closer to death than I am in the safety of my own home.
lines.zh: 比起在自己安全的家里，我在离死亡更近的地方反而更不设防。

lines.en: Ayane speaks again.
lines.zh: Ayane 又开口了。

lines.en: Her words cut through the haze of a trillion dying lights.
lines.zh: 她的话语穿透了万亿点正在熄灭的光所织成的雾霭。

lines.en: : This is a lot better, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 这儿好多了，你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I guess. It’s a little hot, though.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过有点热。

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} a little hot, though.
lines.zh: : 可{i}你{/i}有点火辣嘛。

lines.en: : Hilarious.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。

lines.en: : Hey! I’ll have you know that I consistently rank among the top ten funniest girls in our class based on the polls I force Sana to run online.
lines.zh: : 嘿！你可听好了，根据我逼 Sana 在网上发起的投票，我稳定地位居我们班最搞笑女生前十名。

lines.en: : I’m honestly amazed that she hasn’t asked for a new roommate yet.
lines.zh: : 我真惊讶她到现在还没申请换个室友。

lines.en: : And {i}I’m{/i} honestly amazed by {i}how hot you are.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而{i}我也{/i}真惊讶，你居然这么{i}火辣{/i}。

lines.en: : Ayane, please.
lines.zh: : Ayane，拜托。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m done now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不说了。

lines.en: : For real, though. Doesn’t it feel much better up here?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。在上面是不是感觉好多了？

lines.en: : I’ve never actually been on the roof of the school before- just heard about it from Ami. But my bedroom at home did have a window I could climb out of and sit on the roof.
lines.zh: : 我其实从没上过学校的天台——只是听 Ami 说过。不过我家的卧室有扇窗，我可以翻出去坐在屋顶上。

lines.en: : I remember doing that a lot after my mom left.
lines.zh: : 我记得我妈走了之后，我经常那么做。

lines.en: : And I guess it became some sort of coping mechanism for me or something like that since I’m still compelled to climb as high as I can whenever I’m feeling down.
lines.zh: : 我想那大概成了我某种应对机制之类的东西，因为直到现在，只要心情不好，我就还是忍不住要爬到尽可能高的地方。

lines.en: : Even your worries seem smaller when you’re this far off the ground.
lines.zh: : 哪怕是你那些烦恼，离地这么远的时候看起来也变小了。

lines.en: : And I’m not saying that the reason I brought you up here is to try and force the way I handle things on you-
lines.zh: : 我不是说，我把你带上来的目的就是想把我处理事情的方式强加给你——

lines.en: : I just thought it might be a little easier to breathe in a place with more air.
lines.zh: : 我只是想，在一个空气更多的地方，也许会更容易呼吸一点。

lines.en: : That line would have been a lot better if higher altitudes didn’t make it {i}harder{/i} to breathe.
lines.zh: : 要是高海拔不会让人{i}更难{/i}呼吸的话，这句台词会好很多。

lines.en: : Ooh! Maybe we should just have class on the roof from now on if being up here is going to help you remember cool facts like that?
lines.zh: : 哦！那我们要是从今往后就在天台上上课好了，反正待在上面能让你想起这么酷的知识。

lines.en: : Thank you, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Ayane。

lines.en: : Not for your sarcastic teaching comment, but for looking out for me even when you probably shouldn’t be.
lines.zh: : 不是谢你那句关于上课的讽刺，而是谢你在我恐怕不该被照顾的时候，还在照顾我。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不客气，Sensei。

lines.en: : You were there for me, so I’ll be here for you.
lines.zh: : 你曾经陪在我身边，所以我也会陪在你身边。

lines.en: : I didn’t expect you to actually thank me, though. It’s not really like you to lean into serious moments like this.
lines.zh: : 不过我没想到你真的会谢我。你平时不太会认真对待这种严肃的时刻。

lines.en: : But I guess we all act a little differently when we’re on top of the world.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，当我们站在世界顶端的时候，每个人的表现都会有点不一样。

lines.en: : Oh! Here’s a fun idea. How about we take turns admitting some of our deepest, darkest secrets to one another? That’ll help kill some time before we head back, won’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦！我有个好玩的主意。要不我们轮流跟对方坦白一些内心最深、最黑暗的秘密？这样在回去之前也能打发点时间，不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m good. I don’t really have anything I’m actively hiding from you anyway.
lines.zh: : 我就不用了。反正我也没什么刻意瞒着你的事。

lines.en: : What? Really? Well, that’s no fun.
lines.zh: : 什么？真的吗？那多没意思。

lines.en: : I guess we’ll just have to have sex instead, then.
lines.zh: : 那我看，我们就只好改做爱了。

lines.en: Wait, what?
lines.zh: 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Was that for real? Because it’s hard to tell with you sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你是认真的吗？因为跟你相处，有时候真的很难分辨。

lines.en: : Yeah. It was.
lines.zh: : 嗯。是认真的。

lines.en: : I’m a little nervous, but...I think I’m ready.
lines.zh: : 我有点紧张，不过……我想我准备好了。

lines.en: : Assuming you’re still okay with it, of course. Because I absolutely wouldn’t blame you if you felt weird about this and, like...wanted to wait until I graduate or something.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你还愿意。因为如果你对这事感觉别扭，比如……想等我毕业再说什么的，我绝对不会怪你。

lines.en: : What would waiting that long change?
lines.zh: : 等那么久又能改变什么？

lines.en: : You’ll still be my niece’s best friend and I’ll still be a man who was supposed to be looking after you.
lines.zh: : 你依然是我侄女最好的朋友，我依然是那个本该照顾你的男人。

lines.en: : This is wrong no matter what angle you look at it from.
lines.zh: : 不管从哪个角度看，这都是错的。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But this is a mistake I’ve wanted to make for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 可这是一个我想了很久、很想犯的错误。

lines.en: : And I am also very horny right now.
lines.zh: : 而且我现在也非常想要。

lines.en: : Sounds like a pretty normal day for you.
lines.zh: : 听起来你平时也差不多。

lines.en: : I am a girl in love in the throes of puberty and I will not allow you to shame me for my overactive imagination and desire to touch you.
lines.zh: : 我是一个正值青春期、坠入爱河的女孩，我不允许你因为我过于活跃的想象力、以及想碰你的欲望而让我感到羞耻。

lines.en: : I’m not shaming you for anything. Nor am I trying to talk you out of it since I have no intention of refusing.
lines.zh: : 我没有因为任何事让你感到羞耻。我也没打算劝你放弃，因为我根本不打算拒绝。

lines.en: : Then-
: I just need you to promise that no one will ever find out about this.
lines.zh: : 我只要你答应我，这件事永远不会被任何人知道。

lines.en: : Because, if they do-
lines.zh: : 因为，如果被人知道了——

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m not an idiot. I may be blindly in love, but even a blind woman would be able to prevent herself from diving head first into a meat grinder.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我不是白痴。我也许是盲目地爱着，但就算是瞎子，也懂得别一头扎进绞肉机里。

lines.en: : Please refrain from using the word “meatgrinder” while I am in the process of forming an erection.
lines.zh: : 在我正在勃起的过程中，请别用“绞肉机”这个词。

lines.en: : I am about to sleep with my friend’s uncle...who is also my teacher...who is also nearly double my age.
lines.zh: : 我马上要跟我朋友的舅舅上床了……他还是我的老师……而且年纪几乎是我的两倍。

lines.en: : I’m obviously going to keep that a secret.
lines.zh: : 我显然会保守这个秘密。

lines.en: : When I say I love you, I don’t mean immature, schoolgirl love. I mean {i}real{/i} love. The kind that is protective and loyal and understanding.
lines.zh: : 我说我爱你，指的不是那种不成熟的女学生式的爱。我说的是{i}真正{/i}的爱。那种会保护你、忠于你、理解你的爱。

lines.en: : I will do anything you ask me to, and {i}not{/i} because I’m worried that you’ll leave if I don’t-
lines.zh: : 你让我做什么我都愿意，而且{i}不是{/i}因为怕我不做你就会离开——

lines.en: : But because I want you to be happy.
lines.zh: : 而是因为我想让你幸福。

lines.en: : I want us to be happy together.
lines.zh: : 我想让我们两个一起幸福。

lines.en: : But right now-
lines.zh: : 可现在——

lines.en: : More than anything-
lines.zh: : 我最想要的——

lines.en: Ayane excitedly and hurriedly pulls me through the halls by the wrist, occasionally turning around and giggling.
lines.zh: Ayane 兴奋又急切地拉着我的手腕穿过走廊，时不时回过头来咯咯笑着。

lines.en: It’s a childish giggle that fills me with a sense of lustful dread in both knowing and accepting that I am about to cross a boundary that I {i}know{/i} should not be crossed-
lines.zh: 那是一种孩子气的笑声，让我心里涌起一种色情的恐惧——因为我既清楚、也接受了，自己马上就要越过一条我{i}知道{/i}不该越过的界线——

lines.en: And yet none of the horrible things that I have acknowledged both verbally and mentally even partially dissuade me.
lines.zh: 然而，那些我已经在口头上和心里承认过的可怕后果，没有一件哪怕稍微劝退了我。

lines.en: This is who I am.
lines.zh: 我就是这样的一个人。

lines.en: I am not built for love- but if I can help someone like Ayane {i}feel{/i} loved while gaining something for myself in return...
lines.zh: 我不是为爱而生的——但如果我能让 Ayane 这样的人{i}感受到{/i}被爱，同时自己也有所收获……

lines.en: I will help her time and time again.
lines.zh: 那我会一次又一次地帮她。

lines.en: And I will take her body in my hands, the same way she has dreamt of time and time again-
lines.zh: 而我会把她的身体捧在手心，就像她反复梦见过的那样——

lines.en: And cocoon myself in the idea that I am only as broken as she thinks I am.
lines.zh: 并把自己裹进这样一个念头里：我只有她以为的那么破碎。
